# Setup
```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(HDF5Array)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Load EiaD Gene Counts (cpm)
```{r}
cts <- loadHDF5SummarizedExperiment("~/data/vogda/eiad/se_h5/se_gene_cpm_human.20261013.hdf5/")
```

# Load EiaD Exon Counts (cpm)
```{r}
exon <- loadHDF5SummarizedExperiment("~/data/vogda/eiad/se_h5/se_exon_cpm_human.20261013.hdf5//")
```

# Load Eiad Splice Junction (SJ) Counts (cpm)
```{r}
sj <- loadHDF5SummarizedExperiment("~/data/vogda/eiad/se_h5/se_sj_human.20261007.hdf5/")

```

# Load Retina Adult vs Retina Fetal Diff Testing
```{r}
diff <- readRDS('data/eiad_retina_adult_vs_fetal_tx_diff.rds')
```

# ANK2 

```{r}
diff$sj_topsplice_gene |> head()
```
## Across the body
```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
gene <- 'KIF1B'
res <- geyser::geyser_boxplot(
    rse = cts,
    features = gene,
    groupings = c("Tissue"),
    slot = "cpm",
    feature_col = "gene_name",
    color_by = "Tissue",
    color_palette = "okabe",
    expression_scale = TRUE,
    show_points = TRUE,
    data_source_name = "EiaD"
)

res$plot +coord_flip() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
  legend.position = "none")
```

## Across adult and fetal retina
```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
retina_cts <- cts[,(cts$Tissue == 'Retina' & !grepl("AMD", cts$Perturbation))]
res <- geyser::geyser_boxplot(
    rse = retina_cts,
    features = gene,
    groupings = c("Tissue", "Age", "Source"),
    slot = "cpm",
    feature_col = "gene_name",
    color_by = "Tissue",
    color_palette = "okabe",
    expression_scale = TRUE,
    show_points = TRUE,
    data_source_name = "EiaD"
)

res$plot +coord_flip() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
  legend.position = "none")
```


## ANK2 Exon Counts (Retina only)
```{r, fig.height=100, fig.width=15}
retina_exon <- exon[,(exon$Tissue == 'Retina' & !grepl("AMD", exon$Perturbation))]
res <- geyser::geyser_boxplot(
    rse = retina_exon,
    features = gene,
    groupings = c("Tissue", "Age", "Source"),
    slot = "cpm",
    feature_col = "gene_name",
    color_by = "Tissue",
    color_palette = "okabe",
    expression_scale = TRUE,
    show_points = FALSE,
    data_source_name = "EiaD",
    facet_ncol = 5
)

res$plot +coord_flip() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
  legend.position = "none")
```


# supeRwig Coverage

```{r}
library(supeRwig)

ctx <- supeRwig:::build_context(
  se_dir = '~/data/vogda/eiad/EiaD_2026_hdf5/',
  sj_se_dir  = '~/data/vogda/eiad/se_h5/human_junctions_se.20261007/',
  bigwig_base = '~/data/vogda/eiad/bigwig/',
  anno_fst = '~/git/EiaD_build/data/gencode.v48.primary_assembly.annotation.table.fst',
  bigwig_ext = '.bw',
  n_workers = 10
)
# only keep retina
ctx$eiad_meta <- ctx$eiad_meta |> dplyr::filter(Tissue == 'Retina')
# only keep ref junctions
ctx$sj_row_meta <- ctx$sj_row_meta[SummarizedExperiment::rowData(ctx$sj_se)$annot == 1,]
```

```{r}
chr <- j2e_map |> filter(jid == diff$sj_topsplice_gene |> filter(SYMBOL == gene) |> row.names()) |> pull(upstream_exon) |> str_split(":|-|_") |> unlist() |> (\(x) x[1])()
up_coord <- j2e_map |> filter(jid == diff$sj_topsplice_gene |> filter(SYMBOL == gene) |> row.names()) |> pull(upstream_exon) |> str_split(":|-|_") |> unlist() |> (\(x) x[2])() |> as.integer()
down_coord <- j2e_map |> filter(jid == diff$sj_topsplice_gene |> filter(SYMBOL == gene) |> row.names()) |> pull(downstream_exon) |> str_split(":|-|_") |> unlist() |> (\(x) x[3])() |> as.integer()

# 2. Script plot generation directly to self-contained HTML files
a <- supeRwig::plot_wiggle(
  ctx,
  chr           = chr,
  start         = up_coord-1000,
  end           = down_coord+1000,
  facet_cols      = c("Tissue", "Age"),
  color_by        = "Tissue",
  show_junctions  = TRUE,
  #target_gene   = "ANK2",
  min_psi5        = 10,
  min_psi3        = 10,
  overlap_factor = 0.8,
  mean_average = TRUE,
  interactive = FALSE
)

b <- supeRwig:::plot_region_heatmap(
  ctx           = ctx,
  chr           = chr,
  start         = up_coord-1000,
  end           = down_coord+1000,
  facet_cols    = c("Tissue", "Age"),
  #target_gene   = "DPY19L2P2",
  palette       = "magma",       # Viridis magma scheme
  show_transcripts = TRUE        # Aligned transcript models over heatmap
)
b
a$plot
```
